metadata.title: BD+14$^\circ$3061: A Luminous Yellow Post-AGB Star in the Galactic Halo

notes: No star meets either contribution category. BD+14°3061 is described as a high-velocity halo yellow PAGB star moving in a retrograde Galactic orbit (T:p3-b6; T:p6-b10; T:p7-b1), but the paper never states that it is unbound from the Milky Way or establishes an unbound criterion. The comparison stars HD 46703, BD+39°4926, and the M79 PAGB star are likewise not identified as Galactic-unbound candidates (T:p1-b13; T:p3-b7; T:p4-b2).
